verdict.summary: The draft-only skip is correctly limited to the cargo-fuzz corpus-replay job, preserves non-PR runs and the existing fail-closed selection guard, and allows standing ci-full/fuzz-full labels to override the skip. The existing ready_for_review trigger ensures the same PR head is replayed after leaving draft state, while differential-smoke remains active on drafts. The behavioral tests exercise unlabelled and unrelated-labelled drafts, both override labels, non-draft and non-PR events, and composition with label-flip suppression. The test expression evaluator's object-filter support is appropriately scoped and handles absent paths without raising. Documentation matches the workflow behavior.
